about: A paper that argues for one thesis by analysing what earlier sources did (decisions, trials, studies). Facts are holdings: subject --relation--> source. PaperOrchestra reads genre.json in the template folder and skips its number-fact gate when numeric_facts is false.
argument_plan: Set out the issue and the relevant sources.
Analyse the {SUBJECT_PLURAL} in time order and what each did with each source.
Defend the thesis; then state the strongest counter-argument and answer it from the holdings.
